title: Yellow Labrador in Flowers
description: A vibrant digital painting features a close-up portrait of a yellow Labrador retriever with bright yellow-green fur, floppy ears, and a dark nose, gazing directly at the viewer. The dog is surrounded by a dense background of colorful hibiscus flowers in shades of purple, pink, orange, and yellow.
